name: Focus ring hop
oneLiner: a screenshot floats in a window with slow 3D drift; a lit focus ring locks onto one real region while the page around it dims, then hops to the next and the next (it lifts, swells and lands with a pulse) as the camera glides along, a numbered chip popping under each stop
say: when the speaker walks through the parts of one screen in order ('first the headline, then the offer, then the proof'): cut in on 'first', each hop lands on the word that names the next part. Set stops to the real regions in % of the screenshot (x,y,w,h; 2 or 3, separated by ;) and labels to one short name each
